Visual gallery

Five interface identities. One control system.

These live CSS previews show the design language of each full interface theme. The userscript themes themselves are unchanged by this documentation site.

Map Command

Restrained, high-contrast and map focused.

Cyberpunk

Neon cyan, warning-yellow and magenta telemetry.

Fallout 4

Green phosphor terminal styling with worn industrial panels.

Umbrella

Clinical black, white and red containment presentation.

Factorio

Industrial controls, amber machinery and mechanical status panels.

007 Intelligence

Classified dossiers, gun-barrel geometry and champagne-gold controls.

Hyrule Command

Parchment, royal gold and ancient-energy command styling.

The Godfather

Old-money crime-family command styling with original wax, rose, brass, pinstripe and polished-wood artwork.
